description:
Test build, not a release. For stable builds use main/bundles/stable.json.

- Disable ads (free): hides rif's own "Ads & pro features" and "Hide ads (reddit premium)" switches and keeps rif's pro features on. If you had "Ads & pro features" off, pro features (tablet layout, cards, moderator tools, history sync) turn back on.
- Disable ads: no more empty grey strip at the bottom with themes that place an ad there.
